items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Tootie was named Tootie when my grandfather Sandy Wall first saw Tootie

ctx.x: Percy Sr. and Arlethia, which is the only one I’ve ever heard. My mother’s name is Arlethea. Her maiden name was Wall.
You have a sister and brothers. Can you give their names?
